glass_widow.text: Glass Widow inbound. Watch her fangs.

parallax_hunter.text: Parallax Hunter. Three shadows. One killer.

choir_unbound.text: Choir Unbound. Silence them, one by one.

cinder_manta.text: Cinder Manta. Keep clear of the furnace.

needle_saint.text: Needle Saint on approach. Never fly straight.

blind_leviathan.text: Blind Leviathan. It can hear you move.

lantern_eater.text: Lantern Eater incoming. Something hungry in the dark.

scissor_twins.text: Scissor Twins. Do not let them box you in.

red_wake.text: Red Wake. Fast mover. Mind the trail.

foldship.text: Foldship arriving. Those wings are weapons.

doorwraith.text: Doorwraith. Watch where the shots come out.

clockray.text: Clockray. Those shots will not stay frozen.

horizon_biter.text: Horizon Biter. That mouth is not decorative.

rift_surgeon.text: Rift Surgeon. Keep moving. Keep your distance.

bloom_queen.text: Bloom Queen. Beautiful does not mean friendly.

brood_ark.text: Brood Ark incoming. Take out the hatcheries.

carrion_weaver.text: Carrion Weaver. It wants what is left of you.

spore_monk.text: Spore Monk. Do not linger in its wake.

magnet_urchin.text: Magnet Urchin. Give those spines some room.

chrysalis_hunter.text: Chrysalis Hunter. Crack the shell. Stay sharp.

rail_cathedral.text: Rail Cathedral. Heavy guns. Small windows.

siege_orchid.text: Siege Orchid. Those petals pack artillery.

bulwark_hauler.text: Bulwark Hauler. Strip the armor. Find the heart.

prism_bastion.text: Prism Bastion. One beam becomes three.

cable_kraken.text: Cable Kraken. Cut the limbs before they close.

switchyard.text: Switchyard. Incoming fire can change direction.

false_sun.text: False Sun. That light is hunting you.

signal_thief.text: Signal Thief detected. Trust your eyes, pilot.

lantern_mimic.text: Lantern Mimic. That is not a pickup.

afterimage_duelist.text: Afterimage Duelist. Shoot the one that shoots back.

surveyor.text: Surveyor inbound. Do not give it a clean reading.

cipher_engine.text: Cipher Engine. New pattern. Same trigger finger.

thunder_loom.text: Thunder Loom. Find the break in the storm.

avalanche_engine.text: Avalanche Engine. Keep your escape lane open.

ricochet_duchess.text: Ricochet Duchess. Watch the return shots.

lantern_shoal.text: Lantern Shoal. The whole school bites.

nova_anvil.text: Nova Anvil. Stay out from under it.

gilded_pilgrim.text: Gilded Pilgrim. Make it pay for the visit.

vault_crawler.text: Vault Crawler. Crack it open, pilot.

oathkeeper.text: Oathkeeper. It came looking for a duel.

courier_zero.text: Courier Zero. Fast delivery. Bad intentions.

debt_collector.text: Debt Collector. Tell it we are not paying.

mercy_trap.text: Mercy Trap. Nothing free out here.

fortune_leech.text: Fortune Leech. Shake it off before it settles.

constellation_beast.text: Constellation Beast. The stars just grew teeth.

cathedral_of_teeth.text: Cathedral of Teeth. Keep every gun on that mouth.

dying_star.text: Dying Star. It plans to take you with it.

witness.text: The Witness. It remembers how you fight.
